articles.title: XERJ vs Mem0, Zep, Letta and Cognee for agent memory

articles.summary: How XERJ compares with Mem0, Zep, Letta and Cognee for AI agent memory: what each one stores, what it needs to run, and when to pick each one.
articles.answer: Should I use Mem0, Zep, Letta, Cognee or XERJ for agent memory? Pick Mem0 or Cognee to have a model extract facts and links for you, Zep or Graphiti for facts that change over time, Letta for a full stateful agent. Pick XERJ for plain local memory, searched like any other data, with no generative fact-extraction step.
